digest.component_or_area: test infrastructure / rebar repo template fixture
propositions: The template fixture asserts no-tickets invariant only via a separate test, leaving narrowed test runs without protection when that test is not selected.
Fixture-level assertions fire at construction before any test runs and protect all consumers; test-level assertions fire only when selected.
The no-tickets assertion must run inside the MonkeyPatch context where REBAR_ROOT and cwd are pinned, not at the filesystem level after the context exits.
The template must carry no tickets after rebar.init_repo() and root commit to prevent silent inversion of emptiness assertions in dependent tests.
